source: Pravana ChromaSilk Crème Hair Color technical data sheet

numbering_system.description: Pravana ChromaSilk uses decimal notation where the number before the decimal = Level (1-10) and numbers after the decimal = Tone(s). Single digit after decimal = 100% that tone. Two digits after decimal = primary + secondary tone ratio (70:30). Second digit 0 = Bright shade (e.g., .40). Two identical digits = Intense shade (e.g., .44). First digit 0 = Sheer version (e.g., .02).
numbering_system.high_lift: Ultra Hi-Lifts available for virgin hair level 6+ with 30/40 volume developer

lines.name: ChromaSilk Crème Hair Color (Permanent)
lines.description: 100% grey coverage permanent crème hair color. 0 (Zero Lift) developer for demi-permanent results.
lines.notes: For max un-toned lift without bleach, use 000 Lightening Booster.

lines.name: ChromaSilk Vivids (Semi-Permanent Direct Dye)
lines.description: Semi-permanent direct dyes lasting 3-12 weeks. Must pre-lighten hair before application. Mix with Vivids Clear to lighten/pastelize.
lines.notes: Available in standard, Neon, Pastel, and Locked-In series.

lines.name: ChromaSilk Express Tones (Additives)
lines.mixRatio: Mix into ChromaSilk formula as needed
lines.processingTime: Same as ChromaSilk Crème Color (30-45 minutes)
lines.description: Concentrated tone additives for custom color correction and tonal direction within ChromaSilk formulas.
lines.notes: Do not use Express Tones on their own. Always mix with ChromaSilk Crème Color.

lines.name: ChromaSilk Color Correctors + Additives
lines.mixRatio: Mix into ChromaSilk formula as needed
lines.processingTime: Same as ChromaSilk Crème Color (30-45 minutes)
lines.description: Primary color correctors for neutralizing unwanted tones.
lines.notes: Use green to neutralize red, violet to neutralize yellow, blue to neutralize orange, orange to neutralize blue, red to neutralize green, yellow to neutralize violet.

0_vol.use: Deposit only, demi-permanent results, grey blending, tone-on-tone

10_vol.use: Deposit only, grey coverage, tone-on-tone, darker coloring

20_vol.use: 1-2 levels of lift, grey coverage, standard permanent color service

30_vol.use: 2-3 levels of lift, resistant hair, Ultra Hi-Lifts on virgin hair level 6+

40_vol.use: 3-4 levels of lift, Ultra Hi-Lifts on virgin hair level 6+

gray_coverage.rule: 100% grey coverage on all ChromaSilk Crème Hair Color shades
gray_coverage.processing_time: 30 minutes minimum; extend to 45 minutes for resistant grey
gray_coverage.resistant_hair: Use 20-30 volume developer for resistant grey; pre-soften with 000 Booster if needed

grey_coverage.standard: 100% on all permanent shades with appropriate developer
grey_coverage.resistant: Use 20-30 volume developer; extend processing to 45 minutes
grey_coverage.processing: 30 minutes standard; 45 minutes for resistant grey

ultra_hi_lifts.eligibility: Virgin hair level 6 or lighter only

lightening_booster.name: Lightening Booster
lightening_booster.use: Add to any ChromaSilk formula for maximum un-toned lift without bleach
lightening_booster.mixing: Mix with chosen ChromaSilk shade and developer as normal
